this was Diggs' fourth consecutive time as host.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/12/nicole-byer-taye-diggs-host-critics-choice-tv-awards-the-cw-1234888803/ |title=Nicole Byer & Taye Diggs to Host Critics Choice TV Awards on The CW & TBS |last=White |first=Peter |date=December 10, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=December 10, 2021}} The television nominations were announced on December 6, 2021.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/12/critics-choice-awards-tv-nominations-2021-succession-hbo-netflix-1234885460/ |title=Critics Choice TV Nominations: 'Succession' Leads Field as HBO edges Netflix |last=Pedersen |first=Erik |date=December 6, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=December 6, 2021}} The film nominations were announced on December 13, 2021.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/12/critics-choice-awards-film-nominations-2022-1234889884/ |title=Critics Choice Awards Film Nominations Led by 'Belfast' and 'West Side Story' |last=Hammond |first=Pete |date=December 13, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=December 13, 2021}} ''[[Belfast (film)|Belfast]]'' and ''[[West Side Story (2021 film)|West Side Story]]'' led the film nominations with 11 each, followed by ''[[Dune (2021 film)|Dune]]'' and ''[[The Power of the Dog (film)|The Power of the Dog]]'' with 10 apiece. ''[[Succession (TV series)|Succession]]'' led the television nominations with eight, followed by ''[[Evil (American TV series)|Evil]]'' and ''[[Mare of Easttown]]'' with five each. Overall, [[Netflix]] received a total of 42 nominations, 24 for film and 18 for television, the most for any studio or network for the fifth year in a row. On December 22, 2021, the ceremony, originally slated for January 9, 2022, was delayed due to [[COVID-19 pandemic]]-related concerns—involving the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]] widespread surge in the United States.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/12/critics-choice-awards-postponed-due-to-covid-concerns-new-date-tba-1234900978/ |title=Critics Choice Awards Postponed Due to Covid Concerns; New Date TBA; Motion Picture Academy Postpones Theatre Re-Openings |last=Hammond |first=Pete |date=December 22, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=December 22, 2021}} On January 13, 2022, it was announced that the ceremony would take place on March 13, 2022. ==Winners and nominees== ===Film=== [[File:Jane Campion DNZM (cropped).jpg|right|thumb|150px|[[Jane Campion]], Best Director and Best Adapted Screenplay winner]] [[File:TechCrunch Disrupt 2019 (48834434641) (cropped).jpg|right|thumb|150px|[[Will Smith]], Best Actor winner]] [[File:SDCC 2015 -
